```{=html}
<style>
  .soloyield-controls {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 1rem 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  }
  @media (max-width: 520px) {
    .soloyield-controls { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
  .soloyield-controls .control-item label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #666;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    margin-bottom: 0.35rem;
  }
  .soloyield-controls .slider-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.75rem;
  }
  .soloyield-controls input[type=range] {
    flex: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
    accent-color: #444;
  }
  .soloyield-controls .slider-value {
    font-size: 1.05rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    min-width: 3.5rem;
    text-align: right;
    color: #111;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  #soloyield-chart { width: 100%; height: 460px; }
  .soloyield-caption {
    font-size: 0.76rem;
    color: #999;
    margin-top: 0.6rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
</style>

<div class="soloyield-controls">
  <div class="control-item">
    <label for="taxSlider">Income tax rate</label>
    <div class="slider-row">
      <input type="range" id="taxSlider" min="0" max="100" value="40" step="1">
      <span class="slider-value" id="taxValue">40%</span>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="control-item">
    <label for="elSlider">Execution layer return</label>
    <div class="slider-row">
      <input type="range" id="elSlider" min="0" max="4" value="0.15" step="0.05">
      <span class="slider-value" id="elValue">1.0%</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div id="soloyield-chart"></div>


<script src="soloyield.js"></script>
```
